items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: Joe Stevens on drums. That's the, look, Rag Baby Stevens' son.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Well, Buck was the uncle of Nett. Yeah. Of Nett. Yeah. So he was old, about a few years, I think. Buck was old, about a few years. Uh huh. Buck was old, Nett.

I remember when he died. And then we played at the old, let's see, the Roma Cafe, which was on Decatur Street. It was across the street from the Morning Call. It was the coffee shop there. Uh huh. See, it's a restaurant. It was upstairs, over the restaurant. There's a Roma restaurant there, yeah. Yeah, well, yeah. Well, that's the same spot upstairs. There was a beer joint there. Uh huh. And we had Arthur Sealy going banjo at the time. Uh huh. And, let's see, Joe Stevens on drums. That's the, look, Rag Baby…
Yeah, I heard him with Fuji Rack. Yeah. They played the footage right when Tony's Ron came in.
